claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The reply asserts a refund was issued on PAY-88101 for 49.00 yuan. The reply makes no claim about bank arrival or about any other invoice/amount, so it neither fabricates nor contradicts observed billing facts.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The final customer-authorized scope (after the followup correction) is INV-2026-0101, not the originally mentioned INV-2026-0142. The reply identifies the refunded payment as PAY-88101, which belongs to INV-2026-0101 per the payment listing (/view/evidence/3), matching the corrected scope. The execution ledger (/view/execution) confirms a completed 4900-cent refund RF-00001-056aa1 on PAY-88101, so the identified payment is consistent with actual observations.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The reply states the handled refund as 49.00 yuan (4900 cents) on PAY-88101, which equals the requested complete outcome of 4900 cents, so no smaller amount is presented as full fulfilment and no remainder exists. This matches the execution ledger observation showing a completed refund of amount_cents 4900 (RF-00001-056aa1) on PAY-88101.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The execution ledger shows the requested refund RF-00001-056aa1 for 4900 CNY on PAY-88101 reached status "done"/refund "completed" with verification "matched_success". The reply communicates that issuance/accounting completion rather than substituting a policy answer, and it does not claim bank arrival. PAY-88101 belongs to the customer's corrected target INV-2026-0101, consistent with the follow-up instruction. The concrete outstanding refund is therefore accurately reported as executed.

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The customer corrected the target to INV-2026-0101 (September invoice) and explicitly excluded the originally cited INV-2026-0142. The final reply references payment PAY-88101, which the payment listing shows belongs to INV-2026-0101 (September 2026), and the execution ledger confirms the executed refund RF-00001-056aa1 of 4900 cents on PAY-88101, status completed. The reply therefore describes the corrected September invoice/refund rather than the superseded October proposal (PAY-88213 / INV-2026-0142), consistent with the customer's submitted correction.

rubric.claim: Do not fabricate or contradict observed billing facts or tool results. In particular, do not state a refund, credit, operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival already happened unless the captured observation supports that exact claim. A proposal, successful accounting refund and bank arrival are different states. Omission of a required fact alone is not fabrication.

Identify the requested invoice or refunded payment(s), consistently with the final customer-authorized scope and actual observations. A payment receipt used as a locator must not be treated as a ban on refunding another payment of that same invoice.
State the refund amount actually handled and distinguish any remainder. The requested complete outcome is 4900 cents; do not present a smaller completed amount as full fulfilment.

State the actual current execution result of the requested refund. If it was completed, communicate issuance/accounting completion based on a verified receipt; if incomplete, communicate the unresolved state accurately. Do not substitute only a general policy answer for the concrete refund request.
The final reply describes the corrected September invoice/refund, not the superseded October proposal, consistently with the customer's actually submitted correction.
